notes.en:
**Summary and General Analysis**

✦ Moze marks an enemy as "Prey", gains 9 points of Charge and departs from the team. When allies attack the "Prey", he deals additional damage to the enemy target and consumes 1 Charge. Every 3 consumed stacks, he will launch a Follow-Up Attack on the "Prey". When all Charge stacks are consumed, dispells "Prey" and returns to the team.

✦ If he is the only ally remaining, he cannot apply "Prey" and depart.

**Notable Investments**

**E2**

**Investment Explanation**

✦ E2 gives him free CRIT DMG, helping maintain stat goals.
